Frequently Asked Questions

Every shipment is 100% insured and encased in custom shock-absorbing molded pulp inside an impact-resistant plywood crate. In the rare event of damage, simply email us a photo within 48 hours for immediate priority replacement or a 100% refund—zero dispute.
Yes. Unlike low-fire decorative terracotta, all KÉRÀMA vessels are vitrified at 1,280°C and coated internally with a non-toxic liquid-glass glaze seal. They hold fresh water indefinitely without sweating or marking your furniture.
Wipe gently with a soft micro-fiber cloth dampened with lukewarm water. For stubborn marks, use a paste of baking soda and water with gentle circular motion. Avoid harsh abrasive cleaners or petroleum solvents.
Yes. Our Kyoto and Copenhagen atelier accommodates bespoke proportions and specialized glazes for architects and interior designers. Lead times range between 4 to 8 weeks depending on kiln volume.
